act_thesis: Discovery becomes pattern. A care failure (E01–E02) and a private misperception (E04–E05) recur in public (E07–E08) until a many-witness Square event (E15) makes the problem undeniable in fact and disputed in cause. Seraphine and Lucien come to trust each other without fixing each other (E13), and Lucien chooses a person over process by calling Baz (E17).

act_success_criteria: E01 gives the mystery human cost before explanation: the child dies, Seraphine stays with the family; no Shard terminology; the swamp is not mythologised; the site is a Möbius seed of the Mending site only, known to no one (source: v4.1b E01; VAA §3 O1; BC-HONEY-ISLAND-SITE)
E02 separates grief from anomaly; the residue is unnamed (no formal Echo language) (source: v4.1b E02)
Seraphine has a life and a friend before the mystery: Caro's friendship predates page one, shown by behaviour, with no introduction (source: v4.1b E03, R31)
Lucien is introduced through his way of seeing, on a legitimate bounded assignment; the southwest lean appears twice, faint and unnamed (source: v4.1b E04, E11, §13 southwest ladder)
The Vein works as an ordinary room: the scene holds with its anomaly dialogue deleted (source: v4.1b E06 guardrail; BC-VELVET-VEIN-ROOM)
Public recurrence precedes the civic event: a brittle crowd with no puppets (E07); a repeat at the Square under different circumstances (E08) (source: v4.1b E07–E08; BC-JACKSON-SQUARE-RETURN)
S02 produces "Was that similar?", not "This is happening globally" (source: v4.1b S02; BC-REMOTE-SIMILAR, BC-PULSE-NAMING)
E13: neither fixes the other. E14: trust appears in behaviour; no romance declaration, no clue (source: v4.1b E13–E14)
E15 meets its causal card: a many-witness incident with disputed cause; the amp and the two-recording thrum as trials (source: D1, D2, D3; CC §2; M01)
E16 traces a specific consequence of E15 (cleanup, commerce, imperfect comparison) and Lucien admits the problem exceeds solitary solution (source: v4.1b E16)

Act exit: help is coming; the problem is larger than the people asking; Lucien calls Baz personally rather than escalating; no death foreshadowing (source: v4.1b E17; BC-ASKED-HIM-HERE, BC-DOMINION-LADDER)
The Life/Reward units (E03, E12, E14) end on life, not plot (source: v4.1b §13 Life/Reward checksum)
A variety of pleasure and want is visible (amusement, irritation, harmless selfish wants), not only care (source: VAA §4 execution tests)
